propositions: A new advisory AGENT-tier CONTAINER criterion (decomp-shape) must detect layer-cake architectural partitions where children are split by layer (DB/schema, service/API, frontend/UI) instead of vertical slices.

The decomp-shape criterion must detect consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge smells where a child names/consumes an artifact a sibling produces but has no ordering dependency (depends_on/blocks), allowing parallel schedulers to start the consumer before the producer.

The decomp-shape criterion must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED), routed with facet=container and default_posture=advisory, and integrated into CONTAINER_CRITERIA at pass1.py with non-orphan validation.
The eval_solver container-arm must be extended to run container criteria (including decomp-shape) via pass1_container when test fixtures carry a children list, enabling bounded sanity evaluation.

The criterion must auto-flow into the standing effectiveness recorder (criterion_effectiveness.py) with zero per-criterion wiring, and promotion to blocking is deferred until E6 order-sensitivity (fleiss_kappa currently 0.55 < 0.6 floor) clears the prerequisite gate.

Bounded sanity must show recall=1.0 over known layer-cake and consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge positive fixtures, and false-accept=0.0 over vertical-slice and well-ordered negative fixtures, with ≤8 live single-criterion container runs total.
